verdict.rationale: Receipt issuance is a fair question for a payments/POS product, but the evidence pack never documents SumUp sending email/SMS receipts or printing card-network-compliant receipts. The only nearby items do not count: a community developer hacked together a receipt printer via the public API (a user-side workaround), and the POS plan mentions connecting "ticket printers" (an adjacent feature, not receipt compliance).

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can issue digital (email/SMS) or printed receipts that meet card-network requirements
